_comment: Gmail API v1 users.messages.get responses, format=metadata: https://developers.google.com/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages/get . Wrapped in a list here because the real flow is users.messages.list (ids only) then one get per id. Headers are a LIST OF NAME/VALUE PAIRS, not an object, and the casing is not guaranteed -- reading payload.headers['Subject'] is the classic bug. internalDate is epoch MILLISECONDS as a string.

messages.snippet: Picture day has been moved to Friday October 3. Order forms are due back the week before. Please send the form with your student...
Fall soccer registration closes September 30. Late signups cannot be guaranteed a roster spot...
Reminder: this is the third message in the picture day thread. Nothing new here.

headers.name: Subject
headers.value: Re: Picture Day moved to October 3
